=== a function
        .syntax unified
        .text
        .global f
f:      add     r0, r0, r1
        bx      lr
=== data in code marks each change
        .syntax unified
f:      mov     r0, r1
        .word   1, 2
        .byte   3
        .p2align 2
        mov     r1, r2
        .ascii  "ab"
        .balign 4, 0xaa
        bx      lr
=== data before any code is marked from the start
        .syntax unified
        .byte   1
        .p2align 1
        mov     r0, r0
=== space and fill mark their own start
        .syntax unified
        .section .t2, "ax"
        .space  4
        bx      lr
        .section .rodata
        .byte   1
        .space  3
        .byte   2
        .fill   2, 1, 0xee
=== data sections
        .syntax unified
        .data
        .word   1
        .p2align 3
        .word   2
        .section .d2, "aw"
        .p2align 2
        .byte   2
=== an alignment that the code already marked keeps the section's alignment
        .syntax unified
        .p2align 1
        mov     r0, r0
        .byte   1
=== switching to thumb and back within a section
        .syntax unified
        .section .t3, "ax"
        mov     r0, r0
        .thumb
        movs    r0, r0
        .arm
        mov     r0, r0
        .thumb
        bx      lr
=== code 16 and code 32
        .syntax unified
        mov     r0, r0
        .code   16
        adds    r0, r1, r2
        .code   32
        bx      lr
=== a section ending in data is padded with no-ops
        .syntax unified
        mov     r0, r0
        .byte   1, 2, 3
=== an odd alignment remainder in code is data
        .syntax unified
        mov     r0, r0
        .byte   1
        .p2align 3
        mov     r1, r1
=== literal pool at the end of the section
        .syntax unified
f:      ldr     r0, =0x12345678
        ldr     r1, =0x12345678
        ldr     r2, =foo
        ldr     r3, =foo + 4
        ldr     r4, =0xff
        ldr     r5, =0xffffff00
        ldr     r6, =f
        ldr     r7, =-1
        ldr     r8, =0xffffffff
        ldr     r9, =-0x12345678
        ldr     r10, =0xedcba988
        bx      lr
=== ltorg places the pool and starts a new one
        .syntax unified
f:      ldr     r0, =0x12345678
        mov     r0, r1
        .ltorg
        ldr     r0, =0x12345678
        ldreq   r1, =0x87654321
        ldrne   r2, =0x100
        bx      lr
        .pool
        .ltorg
        mov     r0, r0
=== an empty ltorg does nothing
        .syntax unified
        mov     r0, r0
        .ltorg
        .byte   1
        .ltorg
        mov     r1, r1
=== a pool after data is aligned with zeros
        .syntax unified
f:      ldr     r0, =label
        .byte   1, 2, 3
        .ltorg
label:  bx      lr
=== each section has its own pool
        .syntax unified
        .text
        ldr     r0, =0x11111111
        .section .text.b, "ax"
        ldr     r0, =0x11111111
        ldr     r1, =0x22222222
        .text
        ldr     r2, =0x22222222
        .data
        .word   0
=== numbers and symbols do not share an entry
        .syntax unified
        .equ    later, 0x12345678
        ldr     r0, =0x12345678
        ldr     r1, =later
        ldr     r2, =sym
        ldr     r3, =sym + 0
        ldr     r4, =sym - 4
        ldr     r5, =1f
        ldr     r6, =1f
1:      bx      lr
=== a load reaches a pool 4092 bytes past the PC
        .syntax unified
        ldr     r0, =0x12345678
        .space  4092
        bx      lr
=== refused: a load that does not reach its pool
        .syntax unified
        ldr     r0, =0x12345678
        .space  4096
        bx      lr
=== a pool reached backwards is not reused
        .syntax unified
        ldr     r0, =0x12345678
        .ltorg
        .space  8
        ldr     r1, =0x12345678
=== adr forward and back
        .syntax unified
back:   nop
        adr     r0, back
        adr     r1, fwd
        adreq   r2, fwd
        adr     r3, .
        adr     lr, back + 4
fwd:    bx      lr
=== adr to a label an add can reach only at a rotated offset
        .syntax unified
        adr     r0, far
        .space  1012
far:    bx      lr
=== refused: adr to an offset no modified immediate holds
        .syntax unified
        adr     r0, far
        .space  1014
far:    bx      lr
=== adrl in one instruction and in two
        .syntax unified
back:   adrl    r0, near
        adrl    r1, far
        adrl    r2, back
near:   nop
        .space  0x10000
far:    adrl    r3, back
        adrlne  r4, near
        bx      lr
=== refused: adr to another section
        .syntax unified
        adr     r0, other
        .data
other:  .word   0
=== calls between ARM and Thumb functions
        .syntax unified
        .arm
        .global armf
        .type   armf, %function
armf:   bl      thumbf
        blx     thumbf
        bl      armf2
        blx     armf2
        bl      ext
        blx     ext
        b       thumbf
        bx      lr
armf2:  bx      lr
        .thumb
        .thumb_func
thumbf: bl      armf
        blx     armf
        bl      thumbf2
        blx     thumbf2
        bl      ext
        blx     ext
        b.w     armf
        bx      lr
        .type   thumbf2, %function
thumbf2:
        bx      lr
plain:  bx      lr
        .data
        .word   thumbf, armf, thumbf2, plain
=== conditional branches and calls to a Thumb function
        .syntax unified
        bleq    tf
        beq     tf
        b       tf
        bl      tf
        bx      lr
        .thumb
        .type   tf, %function
tf:     bx      lr
=== a local ARM function called from Thumb in the same section
        .syntax unified
        .type   af, %function
af:     bx      lr
        .thumb
tstart: bl      af
        blx     af
        b.w     af
        beq.w   af
        b       af
        bne     af
        bx      lr
=== branches to global and weak symbols in the same section
        .syntax unified
        .global g
        .weak   w
        .global h
        .hidden h
g:      b       g
w:      bl      w
h:      b       h
        blx     g
        .thumb
        .global tg
tg:     b       tg
        bl      tg
        beq     tg
        .global th
        .hidden th
th:     b       th
        bx      lr
=== thumb_func names the next label that is not a local one
        .syntax unified
        .thumb_func
.Lskip: nop
real:   bx      lr
        .thumb_func
        .arm
armcode:
        bx      lr
        .thumb
        .data
        .thumb_func
datalabel:
        .word   0
        .text
later:  bx      lr
        .word   real, later, datalabel
=== the type may come before the label or after it
        .syntax unified
        .thumb
        .type   before, %function
before: bx      lr
after:  bx      lr
        .type   after, %function
        .global before, after
        .arm
        bl      before
        bl      after
        .word   before, after
=== addresses of Thumb functions
        .syntax unified
        .thumb
        .thumb_func
tf:     bx      lr
        .arm
        adr     r0, tf
        adr     r1, later
        ldr     r2, =tf
        ldr     r3, =later
        .thumb
        adr     r4, tf
        .p2align 2, 0
        .thumb_func
later:  bx      lr
=== calls into another section
        .syntax unified
        bl      other
        blx     other
        bl      tother
        blx     tother
        .thumb
        bl      other
        blx     other
        bl      tother
        blx     tother
        .section .text.b, "ax"
        .arm
        .type   other, %function
other:  bx      lr
        .thumb
        .thumb_func
tother: bx      lr
=== references to symbols in their own section, by binding
        .syntax unified
        .text
        .globl  glob, hid, prot, intl, galias, func
        .hidden hid
        .protected prot
        .internal intl
        .weak   weak1, walias, whid
        .hidden whid
        .type   func, %function
        .hidden lhid
start:
        bl loc
        bl glob
        bl weak1
        bl hid
        bl prot
        bl intl
        bl whid
        bl lhid
        bl func
        bl late
        bl lweak
        bl lalias
        bl lwalias
        bl galias
        bl walias
        b loc
        b glob
        b weak1
        b lalias
        b walias
        beq loc
        beq glob
        beq weak1
        beq lalias
        beq walias
        bleq loc
        bleq glob
        bleq weak1
        bleq lalias
        bleq walias
        nop
loc:    nop
glob:   nop
weak1:  nop
hid:    nop
prot:   nop
intl:   nop
whid:   nop
lhid:   nop
func:   nop
late:   nop
lweak:  nop
        .globl  late
        .weak   lweak
        .set    lalias, glob
        .set    lwalias, weak1
        .set    galias, loc
        .set    walias, loc
=== references back to symbols in their own section
        .syntax unified
        .text
        .globl  glob
        .weak   weak1
loc:    nop
glob:   nop
weak1:  nop
        .set    lalias, glob
        bl loc
        bl glob
        bl weak1
        bl lalias
        b loc
        b glob
        b weak1
        beq loc
        beq glob
        beq weak1
        bleq loc
        bleq glob
        bleq weak1
=== references out of their section, by binding
        .syntax unified
        .text
        .globl  oglob
        .weak   oweak, uweak
        .set    oalias, oloc
        bl oloc
        bl oglob
        bl oweak
        bl oalias
        bl ext
        bl uweak
        nop
        .section .text.other,"ax"
oloc:   nop
oglob:  nop
oweak:  nop
=== data referring to symbols, by binding
        .syntax unified
        .data
        .globl  glob, galias, hid
        .weak   weak1, walias
        .weak   uweak
        .hidden hid
        .set    lalias, glob
        .set    lwalias, weak1
        .set    galias, loc
        .set    walias, loc
base:   .long   loc, glob, weak1, hid, lalias, lwalias, galias, walias, ext
        .long   loc - ., glob - ., weak1 - ., lalias - ., walias - .
        .long   glob - base, weak1 - base, base - weak1, lalias - base, walias - base
        .long   ext - ., uweak - .
loc:    .long   0
glob:   .long   0
weak1:  .long   0
hid:    .long   0
=== default section alignment
        .syntax unified
        .text
        .byte   1
        .data
        .byte   2
        .section .rodata
        .byte   3
        .bss
        .space  1
        .section .text.hot,"ax"
        .byte   4
        .section .data.rel,"aw"
        .byte   5
        .section .init,"ax"
        .byte   6
        .section custom,"a"
        .byte   7
